description: This is a Java source file defining a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS devices. It implements an analog watch face with a sweep second hand, handling drawing, ambient modes, style customization, and user interactions.

classes.name: SweepWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService that provides the watch face engine.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Engine instance which handles the watch face drawing and logic.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine that manages drawing, updates, modes, and interactions for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, setting styles, loading resources, and setting up paint and palette.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in device properties such as low-bit ambient and burn-in protection.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Invalidates the display to trigger a redraw each minute.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts drawing style based on ambient mode state.

methods.name: onInterruptionFilterChanged
methods.description: Adjusts display opacity based on mute mode.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Calculates center points and scales background images upon surface size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws watch face components including background, tick marks, and clock hands based on current time and modes.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Register or unregister receivers and update time zones when visibility changes.

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates bounds for peek cards (notifications) for better overlay rendering.
